Greetings Forum members!

You may have noticed that there were some recent changes to the forum groups, in particular the titles assigned based on post counts. Members with over 10 posts are now Drones, and have 2 bronze stars! The more you post, the higher your rank. Some of the now-configured ranks include:

Newbie
Drone
Minion
Gene-Bound
Thorathian
Citizen
Mechanic
Maerynian
Baron
Grand Warlord
Chairman
Sentinel

Happy posting!
